Our team is expanding! Dell Technologies is looking for a Senior DevOps & Infrastructure Support Engineer (APJ) to lead high‑availability, automation and incident‑response across our virtualization, container and lab/manufacturing environments.

What you’ll do
Own regional technical escalations, root‑cause analysis and reliability improvements.
Administer and harden VMware ESXi/vCenter/vSAN, RHEL/CentOS/Rocky and Docker/Kubernetes platforms.
Build and scale Ansible/AWX‑based IaC pipelines and automate firmware/OS provisioning.
Solve complex L2/L3 networking (VLANs, routing, switching) and script in Python/Bash.

What we need
5 – 8+ years in infrastructure engineering, SRE or DevOps.
Deep expertise with RHEL, VMware and container platforms, plus multi‑node Ansible automation
Relevant certifications (VMware VCP/VCAP, Red Hat RHCE, CKA/CKAD, Ansible Specialist) are a plus
